title: 2021 Panini Playoff Rookie Wave Rashod Bateman #RW-RBA NFL Baltimore Ravens
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2021 Panini Playoff Rookie Wave card features Rashod Bateman of the Baltimore Ravens. The card is part of the Rookie Wave insert set and has the card number RW-RBA. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini in the year 2021 and is part of the NFL league. The card is not autographed and features the rookie status of the player. 

The card is a great addition to any football fan's collection and is perfect for fans of the Baltimore Ravens. It is a parallel/variety of the Rookie Wave and has the features of a rookie card. The card is a must-have for collectors and fans alike.
